name: qa-test-data
description: Test data engineering: Faker and factories, WireMock and MSW API mocks, seed datasets, golden files, and boundary, pairwise and negative test inputs. Includes FactoryBot, Mimesis and Bogus, a Mountebank reference, synthetic PII, and a malicious payload bank. Agents (golden-file-manager, test-data-setup-agent) maintain snapshot baselines and set up a feature's full test-data layer.
